notes.title: 3-Player Squads Beta Drops on December 22! Join our Discord for regular updates!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708854/ee3ededbc7806f2aa39d425f4a397c91da7fee66.png

Join us for the 3-Squirrel Squads Open Beta on December 22nd!

You asked for it!

Rally up your friends and start forming your scurries! We'll be running another Open Beta on December 22nd featuring 3-player Squads, more cosmetics, and other major updates.

Servers open:
Friday, December 22nd @ 5:00pm Pacific
The session will run for approximately 4 hours

To play, simply opt-in to the Playtest on our Steam page!

Wishlist today to stay updated through Steam!

Join us on Discord and chat directly with the devs! https://discord.gg/rodentroyale


Follow us on Twitter while you're at it! https://twitter.com/rodentroyale


See you in the neighborhood!
